title: After a Poisonous Primary, Michigan Democrats Promise to Get Along
summary: The party is racing to get behind Dr. Abdul El-Sayed after a Senate primary that was “spirited,” as Pete Buttigieg diplomatically put it at a unity rally on Friday night, but tensions remain.
